tasks.title: Notify adopts the contract patch after #820 and proves parity with its own rules
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, R7, all preconditions, Test test/contract-parity.test.ts, existing tests and Completion evidence; Rollout step 3; Evidence R2/R3 table; Non-goals clientName cap; Security impact dependency pins; Acceptance evidence 4-5. Preserve the requested native blocked-by #820 rollout dependency for a person to link after fan-out. Once ready, add a parity test first and record assertion failures for exactly the bold Evidence rows on the old pin (after #820, b637302); all non-bold controls pass. For every R2/R3 Evidence row, vary only from, to[0] or smtp.clientName on the base email fixture and compare notify channelSchema('email').safeParse success with contract validateNotifyChannelDefinition ok and the literal expected notify 0464b90 boolean. Keep smtp-name and ledger tests passing, including ledger open/revalidation safety described in Rollout step 3.
